newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah falls on liquidity, poll tension.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah falls on liquidity, poll tension.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah fell against the dollar in active early trading on Wednesday on the back of excess rupiah supply, dealers said.

They said ample liquidity appeared to be the main factor for the early fall, but concerns about possible violence before and during Thursday's general elections added to the woes. Spot rupiah fell to an early low of 2,445.25 before recovering slightly to 2,444.75/45.50 at 0220 GMT. It opened at 2,442.0/44.0. Today rupiah was quoted at 2,444.5/46.0.
There was no trade in value tomorrow because there will be no clearing on Thursday to give people a chance to vote.
One local bank dealer said overnight swaps were in negative territory as the overnight rate was traded at 4.5 percent.
Overnight swaps were at -0.5/-0.2, down from par/0.1. The dealer said overnight swaps were slightly firmer later as some operators looked for overnight money at seven percent.
"Sentiment is biddish on the dollar. Some players are trying to test the resistance level at 2,445.0. Once it's broken decisively, we are heading for the 2,450.0 level," he said.
One Japanese bank dealer said Singapore players were seen cashing out from the dollar build-up previously at various levels, but local buying was supporting the downside.
Dealers said the overnight dollar deposit rate was traded at 7.5 percent, which was expensive.
The local bank dealer attributed the high dollar rate to operators selling today dollars with funds borrowed from the dollar deposit market.
One-month swaps were at 12.85/13.75, two at 26.5/28.0, three at 36.5/38.5 and six at 76.5/77.5 points.
The central bank raised its intervention band by one point to 2,414/2,606 but lowered its conversion band by one point to 2,415/2,463 on Tuesday. -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
